data.gender_notes: Somveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Somveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words, ‘Som’ and ‘Veer’. ‘Som’ refers to Lord Shiva, the God of the Universe, and ‘Veer’ means brave or strong. Thus, Somveer is the name of the Lord of the Universe, who is believed to be the source of all strength and courage. The name Somveer carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Somveer usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Somveer is a powerful spiritual name that is believed to bring blessings of strength, courage, and protection from Lord Shiva.
data.etymology: Somveer belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Somveer total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
